guidelines: This Freedom Wall is an independent community board on BetterIriga.org where every Irigueño can leave an anonymous sticky note.
Sticky notes stay right here on this website and are never forwarded or emailed to City Hall.
Protect personal privacy (RA 10173 Data Privacy Act): never post private home addresses, personal mobile numbers, or confidential medical/financial records.
Be kind, constructive, and respectful — share your thoughts, barangay ideas, encouragement, or everyday stories from Iriga City.
